name: Wisdom teeth extraction
summary: How expats arrange wisdom tooth assessment and extraction in Singapore — OPG timing, sedation options, and recovery around flights and spicy food culture.
body:
Impacted wisdom teeth show up on dental check X-rays or after pericoronitis flares. Oral surgeons and some dentists remove them under local anaesthesia, sedation, or GA depending on complexity.

## Decision points
- Symptoms vs prophylactic removal of asymptomatic impacted teeth
- OPG / CBCT when roots near nerves
- Single-side vs all-four sequencing
- Sedation vs local-only for anxiety
- Antibiotic and steroid protocols after surgery

Medical tourism timing is risky if dry socket hits mid-flight home.

## Recovery here
Soft diets clash with chilli and hard hawker crusts — plan porridge days. Swelling peaks around day 2–3 in humid heat. Ask about return-to-gym and diving. Insurance dental riders often carve out wisdom teeth — read schedules carefully.

## How to choose
Prefer clinicians who show the radiograph and nerve-risk discussion, not only a package price. Get written post-op contacts for night bleeding. Confirm whether review stitches are included.

## Practical tip
Book extraction when you can sleep elevated and skip meetings for 48 hours. Stock soft foods before the appointment — Grab decisions hurt when your mouth cannot open.
